oven.name: GE Profile PHS925ST1SS
howToRead: Touch BROIL HI/LO and BAKE at the same time until the display shows SF.
Touch BAKE. The display shows the adjustment: positive is hotter, negative cooler.
Touch START to leave without changing it.
howToChange: Touch BROIL HI/LO and BAKE at the same time until the display shows SF.
Touch BAKE. The display shows the adjustment set now.
Touch BAKE again to switch between positive (hotter) and negative (cooler).
Type the amount on the number pads, e.g. 1 then 0 for 10.
Check the display shows the right sign, then touch START.
howToTurnOffConversion: Touch BAKE and BROIL HI/LO at the same time until the display shows SF.
Touch CONVECTION COOK until the display shows CON OFF.
notes: The adjustment affects baking and roasting, not broil or self-clean, and is kept through a power cut.
The manual doesn't say whether convection has an adjustment of its own; the app assumes it shares bake's.
oven.source: GE PHS925ST1SS owner's manual, pp. 15, 17 and 26; the display's sign confirmed on the oven, and its ~20-minute cycle measured, 2026-11-20.
